perspective:
**Alice Lim’s available information:**

- Alice knows she is a dental hygienist. Austin is her old friend from high school; they have stayed close, discuss their personal and professional lives, and support each other. She knows Austin works in an office/insurance career and that their career paths differ.
- She noticed Austin had become reserved lately when they talked about work. She suspected he might be hiding something about his job performance, felt concerned/curious, and invited him to coffee.
- At coffee, she told Austin she noticed his reserve and asked if things were okay at the office. She heard him say it was “nothing really,” just the usual ups and downs; then he said he wasn’t sure how to handle a few things at work and that it was complicated. She told him he could talk to her.
- After that conversation, Alice believed Austin might be considering a career change because of work dissatisfaction. She felt worried about his well-being. She asked if he had thought about changing careers and said a fresh start can be good. Austin said he had thought about it but didn’t know what other paths to take, and asked what she suggested. She suggested healthcare, offered to tell him more, and offered to connect him with contacts. He said that sounded interesting and wanted to know more about her experiences.
- Alice sensed Austin was hesitant and afraid of the unknown. She felt a mix of frustration and empathy. She told him career changes can be daunting but many succeed, and shared the story of her friend Lara, who switched to healthcare in her late 30s and has never been happier. Austin said it was inspiring but he worried about risks and the initial struggle. Alice encouraged him, saying growth comes from stepping out of comfort zones, and offered her support. Austin thanked her and said it helped knowing he had her support and hearing real success stories.
- Feeling encouraged and hopeful by his openness, Alice suggested Austin talk to a career counselor and mentioned she had friends in healthcare who could give him a clearer picture. Austin said that would be helpful and appreciated the connections. Alice said she would set up a meeting for next week. Austin thanked her and said he was looking forward to it.
- After several discussions and meetings Alice participated in, she believed Austin was ready to take the next steps and appreciated her help. She felt deep satisfaction and joy. She told him she was proud of the steps he had taken and asked how he felt. Austin said he felt excited and a bit nervous, but mostly grateful. Alice proposed regular check-ins. Austin agreed, saying it would keep him focused and that her perspective was good. Alice plans to keep regular check-ins with him.
